findings.text: The after_suite gate the manifest records runs the node's own test file plus tests/test_a_partitioned_landing_builds_no_base_tree.py, tests/test_staged_write_inventory.py and tests/test_every_shared_home_lock_holds_across_nodes.py, but not tests/test_the_landing_pass_measures_and_lands.py, which is the importer test the blocking finding was reproduced against. The repair's central claim -- that a base checkout failure is again reported as a checkout failure -- therefore rests on the negative-control log rather than on the recorded green gate; a targeted rerun at dbfbd62e passes that test (review-check.log in this run's directory).

notes: Incremental review of the commits gained since the run was last reviewed at 366cfd21665ccc1c64e8fb8ca3aee83efb23eea5: acd9b5bfe1 (restore the checkout-failure boundary), faf44633b2 (assert a signalled job records EXIT=143 and removes its tree) and dbfbd62ebe (glob the node-local root the job script exports). Read the diff 366cfd21..dbfbd62e (reckon/crew/queue_landing.py + remodel, tests/test_a_landing_holds_no_fleet_checkout_while_its_job_runs.py +87). Verified the blocking finding's repair by running tests/test_the_landing_pass_measures_and_lands.py::test_an_unusable_scratch_root_refuses_that_run_and_returns and the new test file at dbfbd62e in the reviewed run's worktree: 4 passed, EXIT=0 (review-check.log). Added failures: baseline dd1ff29 log records 61 passed, after dbfbd62e log records 65 passed, both EXIT=0, so added_failure_count 0 from the reviewed run's own arms. Negative controls read: negative-control/base-revision.log (first case red at base), negative-control/checkout-misattribution-without-fix.log (importer test red without the boundary fix), negative-control/signal-without-trap.log (signal case red without the TERM handler, output 'Terminated\nEXIT=0'). The full delivery range dd1ff29..dbfbd62e also carries reckon/crew/promotion_records.py, outside the declared write paths, which the reviewed run records under outside_scope.
